title: Learned causal persistence through measured intervening multimodal state writes
question: Can a learned stateful model preserve an earlier latent bit through actual intervening distracting writes and outperform a reset/no-memory control on same-present opposite-past histories?
hypothesis: The learned recurrent state update preserves the t0 bit across k intervening independent distractor writes, supporting q2 XOR prediction while identical-current reset predictions remain at exactly one correct per opposite-past pair.

protocol.model: learned multimodal observation encoder -> GRUCell state write at t0 AND every intervening distractor -> learned q2 read head

arms.name: persistent_state
arms.intervention: learned GRU state written at t0 then every intervening distractor; q2 consumes state plus current observation

arms.name: reset_before_q2
arms.intervention: use same learned weights but zero state before q2, preserving identical current per pair

arms.name: swapped_history
arms.intervention: exchange final states of opposite-m histories inside each exact paired evaluation

arms.name: oracle_memory
arms.intervention: evaluation-only target m XOR c from held-out generator labels; never provided to model

arms.name: no_intervening_write
arms.intervention: diagnostic model with t0 state fed directly to q2, bypassing distractor updates, same trained weights

decision_rule.condition: All mandatory identity, distinct split, actual write, trained gradient, model input, fingerprint, oracle and reset integrity gates pass; persistent_state mean accuracy at delay4 >=0.90, each seed >=0.75, reset_before_q2 exactly 0.5 on paired episodes, mean paired gap >=0.30 and seed-bootstrap lower 95% bound >0, and opposite-past pair disagreement >=0.90
decision_rule.licenses: Bounded causal learned state retention through actual intervening distractor writes on the registered synthetic paired task.
decision_rule.does_not_license: Semantic memory, arbitrary real-world persistence, adaptation to unseen task families, or C5/sublinear scaling.

decision_rule.condition: All integrity gates pass but any registered capability or robustness threshold fails
decision_rule.licenses: The registered causal persistence success criterion is not established for this protocol.
decision_rule.does_not_license: A universal impossibility or adjusted threshold.

decision_rule.condition: Any mandatory identity, gradient, state change, arm completeness, oracle, reset ceiling, or provenance gate fails
decision_rule.licenses: The instrument is invalid for capability inference and must report INSTRUMENT_INVALID without capability interpretation.
decision_rule.does_not_license: A positive or negative mechanism result.

held_constant: Same paired histories and learned weights for persistent, reset, swapped and no-write evaluation arms
Paired histories at every k have byte-identical current and distractor observations and different t0 bits
m and c independent fair Bernoulli, q2 target m XOR c
Training and evaluation use distinct independent RNG namespaces and fixed random seed list
No model selection or tuning using held-out results
All arms evaluated and emitted even if capability threshold fails
Benchmark-only labels excluded from model inputs
interpretation_order: Generator and paired collision across each nonzero delay
Delay-4 paired gap with seed uncertainty
